shots.text: At the caldera, the Warden of Fire burned grey. When the Cinder Tyrant fell, the grey went out of it all at once.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Cinder Tyrant collapsing in the caldera, grey-white fire guttering. From the cracked basalt steps a tall black-stone figure with an orange molten heart: Ignar.

shots.text: I dreamed I was a cold thing. I am sorry, little ones. I will burn for you now.
shots.speaker: ignar
shots.art_note: Ignar kneeling to Brannoc and the Emberfolk, his heart-light warming their faces.

shots.text: But a land cannot be unburned. The caldera flooded that night, and the Emberfolk walked west, carrying their forge-fires in iron pots.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Pyrrhenhall flooding with steam. A line of Emberfolk carrying glowing iron pots down the mountain toward the distant gold light of Solenne. Ignar walks with them, much taller than anyone.
